page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc9i.large is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture, specifically running on an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor clocked at 3.4 GHz. The instance is configured with 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system and application data. It lacks dedicated GPU hardware, making it unsuitable for accelerated graphics or hardware-dependent machine learning workloads. For connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the dedicated CPU allocation and 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.hfc9i.large offers a balanced entry point for compute-bound tasks that do not require massive memory footprints. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring predictable, non-burstable CPU performance. Suitable workloads include lightweight web serving, application servers, microservices, and basic compilation tasks.
